  warning = FALSE,

if(is.null(work_dir)){work_dir<-tempfile("od-work-");dir.create(work_dir)}

## Purpose

This example uses the supplied 2 km Divvy station groups in Chicago and January 2026 OD counts. The map pools 00:00–03:00 in America/Chicago across all dates in the input.

Directed connections use five trip-count classes: 1, 2–3, 4–5, 6–7 and at least 8. Dashed connections represent one trip. The arrows join station groups and do not identify the route travelled.

## Read and validate the supplied 2 km data

The supplied `r2000` CSV files are the processed inputs for this figure. Extra columns are allowed; only mapped identifiers, coordinates, timestamps, and counts are required.

```{r read-data}
nodes <- data.table::fread(params$node_file, showProgress = FALSE)
flows <- data.table::fread(
  params$flow_file,
  showProgress = FALSE,
  colClasses = list(character = "timestamp")
)

required_node_columns <- c("node_idx", "longitude", "latitude")
required_flow_columns <- c(
  "timestamp", "origin_node_idx", "destination_node_idx", "trip_count"
)

stopifnot(
  all(required_node_columns %in% names(nodes)),
  all(required_flow_columns %in% names(flows)),
  !anyDuplicated(nodes$node_idx),
  all(flows$origin_node_idx %in% nodes$node_idx),
  all(flows$destination_node_idx %in% nodes$node_idx),
  all(is.finite(nodes$longitude)),
  all(is.finite(nodes$latitude)),
  all(flows$trip_count >= 0)
)

data.frame(
  Input = c("2 km nodes", "Hourly OD rows"),
  File = c(basename(params$node_file), basename(params$flow_file)),
  Rows = c(nrow(nodes), nrow(flows)),
  check.names = FALSE
) |>
  knitr::kable(align = c("l", "l", "r"))
```

## Pool all dates over 00:00–03:00

`hour_window = c(0, 3)` is different from a single-date timestamp window. It selects clock hours 00, 01, and 02 from every date, then sums records with the same directed origin and destination. Self-loops remain in the summary but are not drawn as arrows.

```{r pooled-window-check}
parsed_time <- as.POSIXct(flows$timestamp, tz = "America/Chicago")
clock_hour <- as.integer(format(parsed_time, "%H", tz = "America/Chicago"))
selected <- flows[
  clock_hour >= params$hour_start & clock_hour < params$hour_end,
]

pooled <- selected[
  , .(flow = sum(trip_count)),
  by = .(origin_node_idx, destination_node_idx)
]
nonloop <- pooled[origin_node_idx != destination_node_idx]

data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Selected trips including within-node trips",
    "Within-node trips",
    "Nonloop trips",
    "Active directed nonloop OD pairs"
  ),
  Value = c(
    sum(pooled$flow),
    sum(pooled$flow[pooled$origin_node_idx == pooled$destination_node_idx]),
    sum(nonloop$flow),
    nrow(nonloop)
  )
) |>
  knitr::kable(align = c("l", "r"))
```


```{r acquire-context, include=FALSE}
active_ids <- unique(c(nonloop$origin_node_idx,nonloop$destination_node_idx))
active_nodes <- nodes[nodes$node_idx%in%active_ids,]
background <- traffic_basemap(active_nodes,cache_dir=file.path("data","basemap-cache"))
runtime_context <- background
```

## Directed OD map

Curved arrows show trips between the displayed station groups. Only endpoints of the displayed connections are shown.

```{r od-map, fig.width=7.6, fig.height=9.2, out.width="86%"}
map_result <- traffic_od_map(
  nodes = params$node_file,
  flows = params$flow_file,
  basemap = background,
  node_columns = c(
    id = "node_idx",
    longitude = "longitude",
    latitude = "latitude",
    size = "n_raw_stations"
  ),
  flow_columns = c(
    origin = "origin_node_idx",
    destination = "destination_node_idx",
    count = "trip_count",
    time = "timestamp"
  ),
  hour_window = c(params$hour_start, params$hour_end),
  timezone = "America/Chicago",
  top_n = Inf,
  active_nodes_only = TRUE,
  title = "Divvy directed OD flows | 2 km grid aggregation",
  subtitle = paste(
    "January 2026 · all dates pooled over 00:00–03:00 ·",
    "active nodes only"
  ),
  caption = paste(
    "Background: OpenStreetMap contributors; coordinate-based runtime acquisition.",
    "Curved arrows connect aggregate endpoints; they are not observed paths."
  ),
  output_file = params$map_file,
  width = 7.6,
  height = 9.2,
  dpi = 240
)
```

## Displayed-network summary

```{r map-summary}
class_counts <- map_result$summary$flow_classes
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Active nodes displayed",
    "Directed OD pairs displayed",
    "Nonloop trips represented",
    paste0("Flow class: ", names(class_counts))
  ),
  Value = c(
    map_result$summary$displayed_nodes,
    map_result$summary$displayed_pairs,
    map_result$summary$displayed_flow,
    unname(class_counts)
  )
)
knitr::kable(summary_table, align = c("l", "r"))
```

## Aggregation from raw station records

`aggregate_od_data()` reads the raw station and hourly OD tables, validates the
mapped fields, groups nodes with an activity-prioritized radius cover, assigns
each station to its nearest representative, remaps both endpoints and sums the
counts for each time and directed pair. The radius parameter is 1000 m here, as in the generic aggregation example. This is a
radius-cover algorithm; the supplied `r2000` table has an existing grouping and
is retained for the preceding map. Different membership assignments can change
the number of within-node trips while preserving total trips.

```{r aggregate-raw-stations}
aggregated <- aggregate_od_data(
  nodes=file.path(params$data_dir,"nodes_raw.csv"),
  flows=file.path(params$data_dir,"od_flow_2026_01_dt01h_raw.csv"),
  radius_m=params$aggregate_radius_m,
  node_columns=c(id="node_idx",longitude="longitude",latitude="latitude",name="display_name",weight="n_raw_stations"),
  flow_columns=c(origin="origin_node_idx",destination="destination_node_idx",count="trip_count",time="timestamp"),
  timezone="America/Chicago",output_dir=file.path(work_dir,"prepared-od"))
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Item=c("Raw stations","Aggregate nodes","Source OD rows","Aggregate OD rows","Full-month trips","Maximum assignment distance (m)"),
  Value=unlist(aggregated$metadata[c("raw_nodes","aggregate_nodes","raw_flow_rows","aggregate_flow_rows","total_flow","max_assignment_distance_m")])),
  caption="Executed raw-station preparation",row.names=FALSE)
knitr::kable(head(aggregated$nodes),caption="Standardized nodes")
preview_flows <- as.data.frame(head(aggregated$flows))
preview_flows$time <- format(preview_flows$time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z",tz="America/Chicago")
knitr::kable(preview_flows,caption="Standardized time and OD counts")
```

The prepared object and its saved CSV files retain the same time selection.
Explicit UTC/offset timestamps denote absolute instants; timestamps without an
offset use the supplied timezone. Re-reading CSV does not discard the time of
day or reinterpret UTC as local time.

```{r preparation-roundtrip-check}
prepared_map <- traffic_od_map(aggregated,basemap=NULL,
  hour_window=c(params$hour_start,params$hour_end),timezone="America/Chicago",
  top_n=Inf,active_nodes_only=TRUE,draw=FALSE)
roundtrip_map <- traffic_od_map(aggregated$files[["nodes"]],aggregated$files[["flows"]],
  basemap=background,hour_window=c(params$hour_start,params$hour_end),
  timezone="America/Chicago",top_n=Inf,active_nodes_only=TRUE,draw=FALSE)
stopifnot(identical(prepared_map$summary,roundtrip_map$summary),
  aggregated$metadata$total_flow==sum(flows$trip_count),
  prepared_map$summary$selected_flow==sum(pooled$flow),
  aggregated$metadata$max_assignment_distance_m<=aggregated$metadata$radius_m+1e-7)
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Check=c("Full-month trip counts conserved","Source clock-window trip counts conserved","CSV and in-memory plot selections match"),
  Passed=c(aggregated$metadata$total_flow==sum(flows$trip_count),
    prepared_map$summary$selected_flow==sum(pooled$flow),
    identical(prepared_map$summary,roundtrip_map$summary))),caption="Executed end-to-end checks")
```

## Reusing the functions with other OD data

Column mappings make the functions independent of provider-specific names. `start_time` and `end_time` define an absolute date interval. `hour_window` pools the same clock hours across dates.

```{r generic-map-example, eval=FALSE}
traffic_od_map(
  nodes = other_nodes,
  flows = other_flows,
  node_columns = c(
    id = "station", longitude = "x", latitude = "y", size = NA
  ),
  flow_columns = c(
    origin = "from_station", destination = "to_station",
    count = "rides", time = "departure_time"
  ),
  hour_window = c(0, 3),
  timezone = "America/Chicago"
)
```

The generic aggregation interface accepts other mapped node and OD fields:

```{r generic-aggregation-example, eval=FALSE}
aggregated <- aggregate_od_data(
  nodes = raw_nodes,
  flows = raw_flows,
  radius_m = 1000,
  node_columns = c(
    id = "station", longitude = "x", latitude = "y",
    name = "station_name", weight = NA
  ),
  flow_columns = c(
    origin = "from_station", destination = "to_station",
    count = "rides", time = "departure_time"
  ),
  timezone = "America/Chicago"
)
```

## Notes and limitations

- Every OD endpoint must match one mapped node identifier.
- `hour_window` pools matching clock hours across every date in the input.
- Only endpoints of displayed nonloop routes are shown when `active_nodes_only = TRUE`.
- Fixed flow classes make colours comparable across maps.
- OD arrows are visual connections, not observed bicycle trajectories or map-matched routes.
